_comment: Data mau cho tinh nang 'CSKH' (tab Cham soc khach hang). Moi phan tu trong 'events' la BODY gui toi POST http://localhost:9001/api/v1/admin/customer-events/send
DIEU_KIEN_BAT_BUOC: 1) Event chi match vao profile khi da ton tai ProfileSourceRecord cung (sourceSystem, sourceCustomerId) tro toi mot MasterProfile. Neu khong -> syncStatus=UNMATCHED, masterProfileId=null.

2) Cap (CAS, CAS-D003) duoi day la cap DA match vao profile id=69 (dung cap da dung de test service-lines truoc do). Neu profile cua ban duoc tao tu cap khac, hay THAY sourceSystem/sourceCustomerId o TAT CA event ben duoi bang dung cap do.
3) Can dang ky 2 schema Unomi TRUOC khi gui: https://demo.local/schemas/json/events/complaintCreated/1-0-0 va https://demo.local/schemas/json/events/complaintResolved/1-0-0.
4) Moi khieu nai gom 2 event: complaintCreated (luc mo) + complaintResolved (luc dong), noi voi nhau bang field complaintId giong nhau.

5) Luu y nghia nghiep vu: theo tai lieu, khieu nai thuc te nen den tu CRM/Care Don/Call Center, khong phai CAS. O day dung tam sourceSystem=CAS de dam bao match duoc vao profile test co san. Khi lam that (production) can doi lai dung nguon that.
6) messageId/event_code tu sinh UUID trong producer -> khong can dat, khong lo trung.
7) Can Kafka dang chay. Unomi co the tat (sync loi van khong anh huong luu event + match profile).
KET_QUA_MONG_DOI: 3 khieu nai, ca 3 deu da resolved (openComplaints=0), satisfactionScore trung binh ~4.5, slaOnTimeRate cao (dung han).
